title: Act III – Rizzo's Warehouse Final Showdown

lines.speaker: RIZZO
lines.text: You signed with the feds, Moretti. Your family is done[cite: 41].

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: My family is breathing. Yours won't be[cite: 41].

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The warehouse burns into ash. Blood for blood[cite: 44, 46].
